name: zil-site
description: The site: the Starlight reference, the Svelte sandbox, and the wasm build both run. Needs the wasm32-unknown-unknown target and wasm-bindgen-cli at Cargo.lock's wasm-bindgen version.

scripts.build: pnpm build:docs && pnpm wasm && astro build --root docs
scripts.wasm: cargo wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir docs/src/lib/pkg --out-name zil target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/zil_wasm.wasm
